title: Generative AI Overview
description: Generative AI is a cutting-edge field of artificial intelligence that focuses on creating new content by learning patterns from existing data. It employs sophisticated models like Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) to generate realistic images, text, and other media. This technology is revolutionizing areas such as content creation, art, and scientific research by enabling machines to produce high-quality, novel outputs that mimic human creativity.

title: Predictive AI vs. Generative AI: A Comparative Overview
description: Predictive AI analyzes past data to forecast future trends and events, helping make informed decisions. Generative AI creates entirely new content, like images or text, based on patterns learned from existing data. While both use machine learning, generative AI focuses on creating new information, while predictive AI concentrates on predicting the future.

title: Prompt Engineering : Talk to LLM
description: Prompt engineering is method to design input for LLMs to produce desired output. LLMs rely on human guidance through prompts to understand what we want them to do. This is where the art of prompt engineering comes in.

title: Prompt Injection: Attack on Large Language Models
description: Large language models (LLMs) and generative AI (GenAI) are revolutionizing various fields, from content creation to code generation. However, a hidden vulnerability threatens their potential: prompt injection.
keywords: LLMs into deviating from their intended instructions

title: Prompt Templates: Structure Way to Communicate with LLMS
description: Prompt engineering is all about crafting clear and effective instructions for large language models (LLMs). Prompt templates take this a step further, offering a pre-defined structure to streamline prompt creation.
